_note: Authoritative manifest of emblem ids → meaning and scriptural basis. Every entry's `symbol` must be a key here. `node` records the node form the emblem is drawn on (figure = gold medallion, event = eight-lobed seal, text = codex/scroll — the text form arrives with the biblical-books phase). `rendered: false` means the design pass has not yet drawn the glyph and it falls back to a neutral placeholder on the canvas. Keep ids consistent and each emblem tied to the entry's actual story — never generic filler.

genesis-burst.description: Radiant burst of the first light.

eden-tree.description: The tree of the garden with fruit on the bough.

eden-fruit.description: The fruit of the tree with leaf and stem; paired with Adam's tree.
eden-fruit.basis: Genesis 3; Genesis 3:20, "the mother of all living"

fall-serpent.description: The serpent coiled beside the forbidden fruit.
fall-serpent.basis: Genesis 3, the serpent and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil

twin-altars.description: Two altars: one smoke rising straight, one turned aside — regard and no regard.
twin-altars.basis: Genesis 4:4–5, the offerings of Abel and Cain

covenant-bow.description: The bow set in the clouds above the receding waters.

ark.description: The ark riding the waters beneath the bow.

babel-tower.description: The stepped ziggurat with an unfinished top.
